releases.name: Chico's Delivery
releases.summary:
Get ready for a delicious, fun, and fast-thinking adventure in a world where every delivery needs to be perfect. In Chico’s Delivery, you control an adorable pizza-delivery bird that slides endlessly across the environment, turning every stage into a clever and irresistibly addictive puzzle.

But reaching the destination is only part of the challenge. Every table has a counter that decreases with each movement you make, creating a strategic race against time and against your own mistakes. Carefully plan your route, choose the perfect path, and figure out how to serve every table before the orders expire.

The biggest twist comes from the way Chico moves. Once he starts sliding, he only stops when he collides with a wall, obstacle, or environmental object. This turns every movement into an important decision where predicting trajectories and thinking several steps ahead becomes essential for success.

As the journey continues, new mechanics make the puzzles even more creative. Use pizza teleporters, deal with rising tables, take advantage of directional arrows, and learn how to manipulate the environment to create perfect deliveries. Every level introduces a fresh situation that demands observation, logic, and strategy.

With cute visuals, a cozy atmosphere, and clever challenges, Chico’s Delivery offers the kind of relaxing and satisfying experience that makes you want to play “just one more level.” It is the perfect balance between accessible puzzles and increasingly strategic decisions.

Perfect for fans of logic games, casual challenges, and adventures full of personality, Chico’s Delivery transforms simple pizza deliveries into a fun, charming, and surprisingly strategic journey.

Observe the stage, slide through the perfect route, and make sure no pizza arrives late.

releases.name: Hail to the Rainbow
releases.summary:
The story of a lonely young man named Ignat, who survives in the dangerous and gloomy world of post-apocalyptic cyberpunk. The few survivors of the tragic military events had to adapt to the new conditions of existence. Ignat, who lost his parents, was able to build his life alone and learned a lot in this new reality.

However, the life of the protagonist, which has already become familiar in a few years, changes dramatically when an unexpected message arrives by e-mail.

"Hail to the Rainbow" is a first-person story-driven adventure game with horror and shooter elements. In the universe of the game, you will face the dangers of a new reality, immerse yourself in the secrets of the surrounding chaos, and also relive the memories and moral torment of the protagonist. 

Explore the environment, explore electronic records and solve technical puzzles, collect items and upgrade your inventory, this will come in handy on your journey.

releases.name: Modern Sonic Collection
releases.summary:
Three adventures and unlimited speed. Blast through alien amusement parks, rally a resistance, and explore uncharted frontiers in three epic Sonic adventures.

Sonic Forces
The evil Dr. Eggman has taken control of the world. Now you must defeat iconic old villains and fight a powerful new enemy to reclaim the world in this epic new adventure.

Sonic Colors Ultimate
Join Sonic on a high speed adventure to free the Wisps from Dr. Eggman's interstellar amusement park. Race through six vibrant worlds, harness powerful Wisp abilities, and overcome dangerous challenges.

Sonic Frontiers
In search of the missing chaos emeralds, Sonic becomes stranded on an ancient island teeming with unusual creatures. Battle hordes of powerful enemies as you explore a breathtaking world of action, adventure, and mystery.

releases.name: Climber Buddies Crazy Animals
releases.summary:
Cute animals, dangerous jumps, and endless challenges.

Take control of an adorable animal and test your reflexes, precision, and determination in a challenging vertical parkour adventure. Jump across platforms, avoid dangerous traps, collect coins, and climb toward the top while every mistake threatens to send you back to the beginning.

Explore five unique worlds filled with increasingly difficult platforms, obstacles, and tricky jumps. Play solo or grab a friend for local multiplayer, where you can work together to overcome difficult sections or race against each other to see who can climb the highest. Master your movement, control every jump, and stay focused as the climb becomes more demanding.

Key Features:
• Climb Five Unique Worlds: Conquer dungeons, dark fantasy lands, castle ruins, castles, and paradise.
• Race or Team Up: Challenge a friend or work together in local multiplayer.
• Play as Cute Animals: Unlock adorable characters and unique skins.
• Master Every Jump: Use precise movement, double jumps, and aerial control.
• Collect and Customize: Gather coins and unlock new looks for your animal.

releases.name: Classic Sonic Collection
releases.summary:
Decades of classics and endless speed. Spin dash through iconic worlds, celebrate the legacy, and keep going in one epic collection of sonic adventures.

Sonic Mania
Experience classic 2D Sonic action with stunning retro inspired visuals, reimagined fan favorite zones, new bosses, and playable Sonic, tails and knuckles. Race, fly and smash your way through a nostalgic adventure with co op and competition modes.

Sonic Origins
Relive Sonic's most iconic adventures, including Sonic and the hedgehog, Sonic the Hedgehog 2, Sonic 3 and Knuckles, and Sonic CD, fully remastered in high definition. Revisit the games that launched a legend and shaped generations of Sonic fans.

Sonic Superstars
Race through classic sonic platforming reimagined with vibrant 3D visuals, new chaos emerald powers, and an all new adventure. Play as Sonic, Tails, Knuckles or Amy, team up with friends in 4 player co op, and take on Dr. Eggman and his allies across the Northstar Islands.

releases.name: Duskpunk
releases.summary: A gritty dice-driven RPG, in a steampunk city. You escaped the War, but how to survive? Explore the city. Build up your skills. Decide who to trust. Choose carefully: you might just spark a revolution!

releases.name: I Am Your Beast
releases.summary:
I Am Your Beast is a shortform covert revenge thriller FPS about getting hunted across the North American wilderness by the military-industrial complex--and turning the tables.

You are secret agent Alphonse Harding. Retired for six years, you've been asked to complete ‘one last job’, one too many times. Declining your latest mission sets in motion a furious guerilla war between you and the Covert Operations Initiative (COI) that litters the forest with bodies and bullet casings.

Break your opponents. Use their own equipment against them. Duck into your tunnel network before enemy forces zero in on your location. Repeat.

releases.name: Frostpunk
releases.summary: In a completely frozen world, people develop steam-powered technology to oppose the overwhelming cold. Society in its current form becomes ineffective and it has to change in order to survive.

releases.name: Delivery Simulator
releases.summary:
Parcels don’t deliver themselves, and the city won’t make things easy for you. Take the wheel and face the intense daily grind of a delivery driver, navigating busy streets, tight shortcuts, and surprises at every corner. Collect orders, load the cargo, and plan the best route to arrive on time.

Unlock achievements by completing special objectives, beating the clock without crashing your car, and maintaining delivery streaks with no delays. More challenges mean more reasons to improve with every run!

The goal is simple: deliver as much as possible, earn rewards, buy a variety of insane vehicles, and upgrade your operation to become a true reference in the city. Because here, every second counts and every delivery makes a difference!

releases.name: Fishing Valley Remastered
releases.summary:
A fishing adventure where every cast takes you further.

One small boat. One simple rod. A whole valley waiting beyond the next haven.

Fishing Valley Remastered is a quest-driven fishing journey where every trip takes you a little farther. Travel from haven to haven, meet new characters, take on quests, and unlock new waters filled with new species and challenges to discover.

Every catch can move your journey forward. Sell your haul to upgrade your fishing gear and boat, opening the way to more distant waters and tougher catches — or keep your favorite fish and give them a home in your own aquarium.

Some species are easy to find. Others may take the right location, the right equipment, and a little more skill. Chase rare catches, complete your collection, follow the story, or simply take the boat out and enjoy the peaceful rhythm of fishing at your own pace.

• Travel from haven to haven and take on quests along the way
• Discover and collect a variety of fish species
• Upgrade your fishing gear and boat to reach new waters
• Keep your favorite catches and grow your own aquarium
• Follow the story or simply enjoy fishing at your own pace

releases.name: Counter Squad
releases.summary:
Every mission is a new test of your leadership.

Step into the world of Counter Squad, an intense tactical shooter where every operation demands skill, teamwork, and smart decision-making. Command an experienced special forces unit as you clear hostile territory, eliminate armed threats, protect civilians, and complete dangerous assignments in enemy-controlled locations. Success depends on careful planning and flawless execution.

Features:
• Lead an Elite Squad – Take charge of a professional tactical unit trained for high-risk combat operations.
• Plan Every Assault – Use strategy, positioning, and quick decisions to overcome heavily defended enemies.
• Action-Packed Combat – Experience exciting firefights with realistic weapons and responsive shooting mechanics.
• Challenging Operations – Complete a variety of mission objectives while unlocking new equipment and increasingly difficult assignments.
• Multiple Combat Locations – Fight through city blocks, industrial facilities, military compounds, and other hostile environments.
• Constant Battlefield Pressure – Adapt to unexpected enemy movements, reinforcements, and evolving combat situations.

Every mission puts your leadership to the test. Stay focused, protect your team, and complete every objective to prove that Counter Squad is ready for any challenge.

releases.name: Easy Fishing Simulator
releases.summary: Easy Fishing Simulator invites you to unwind by the water with the most accessible fishing experience yet.Cast your line, wait for a bite, and reel in your catch - every step is designed to feel intuitive and rewarding, whether you're a fishing veteran or picking up a rod for the first time.Simple, satisfying gameplay:Cast, hook, and fight fish with easy-to-learn controls. Feel the tension on your line as you reel in everything from tiny minnows to trophy-sized catches.Living waters:Fish behave naturally - swimming, exploring, and reacting to your bait. Every species has its own personality, from cautious bottom feeders to aggressive predators chasing your lure.Progress at your own pace:Sell your catch, earn money, and upgrade your gear to reach new fishing spots and land bigger fish. Keep your favorites or release them back into the water - the choice is yours.Relaxing by designNo pressure, no timers, no stress. Just you, the water, and the next big catch.Grab your rod and cast your first line today.Key features- Easy-to-learn fishing controls, perfect for all ages- Realistic fish behavior and multiple species to discover- Catch, sell, and upgrade your equipment- Relaxing, low-pressure gameplay- Save your progress and keep building your collection

releases.name: SOMEWHERE SMALL
releases.summary:
Turn your Nintendo Switch™ into a cozy pixel-art desk companion.

Keep it on your desk or bedside table as a living art display, set a gentle ambiance with soundscapes, and keep track of your daily tasks with reminders.

■ Make your Nintendo Switch™ a part of your space

Turn your Nintendo Switch into a digital art frame. Explore included pixel-art illustrations and animations, or create your own with the built-in editor. Add ambient sounds while you work, focus, or relax.

■ Keep your day close

Make task lists to track daily routines and upcoming goals. Use the customizable focus timer to shape your work and break sessions around the way you like to concentrate.

■ Wake up gently

When the day winds down, turn your Nintendo Switch into a bedside clock. Set an alarm, settle in, and start tomorrow feeling ready.

Welcome to SOMEWHERE SMALL, a quiet place for your Nintendo Switch, and for you.

releases.name: Dodge Mayhem
releases.summary:
Jetpack Mayhem

Strap on your jet pack and prepare for a high-speed journey through twisting tunnels and dangerous caves!

Each level starts at a manageable pace, but the longer you survive, the faster you go. Dodge the tunnel walls, react quickly and keep your flight under control as the speed continues to increase.

Take on 50 increasingly challenging levels across 5 unique worlds. Early levels are short and simple, but the tunnels become longer, faster and more difficult as you progress.

Complete levels to earn coins, then spend them to unlock new characters and take them along for the ride.

Master your jet pack, survive the speed and make it through every tunnel!

releases.name: Primary School - English Grade 1
releases.summary:
A full year of English adventures! Join 7 lovable characters, blast through countless topics, ace every quiz and become an English superstar.

Make learning English feel easy, structured, and fun. With 7 lovable characters, kids explore the full Grade 1 curriculum through guided lessons, interactive quizzes, and friendly explanations. Smart progress tracking and spaced repetition help strengthen long-term memory. Perfect for parents and children learning together — or for confident young learners practicing independently.

releases.name: Moto X
releases.summary:
Ready, set, go! Six riders compete only one will win!

Revive the moto racing sipirit with this game, developed in 1994.

Compete against motorcycles of 250cc, 550cc, and 750cc in different tracks full of obstacles and the best riders.

Skills aren't going to be enough to win. Throughout the race you will find items that will give you power ups to help you beat your opponents. Use them to your advantage!

releases.name: 123 Early Learning Halloween Games for Kids, Toddlers, Babies
releases.summary: A cheerful Halloween learning game for toddlers, preschoolers and young children! Discover numbers 1 to 20, practice counting and first maths, hear spoken numbers in 14 languages, pop balloons, play memory, solve puzzles and enjoy lots of playful learning activities.

releases.name: Golf Up Oasis
releases.summary:
Enjoy Golf Up Oasis with friends and family!

Golf Up Oasis is a fun-loaded golf game you can play with up to 4 friends in several game modes. In Tournament mode, you can pick between the Classic or Points options, in which you earn points by getting good results in the Holes and making quick decisions for bigger bonuses.

releases.name: Top Down Rally Racing
releases.summary: Speed across sun-soaked island resorts in this fast-paced top-down rally racer. Tear through coastal roads, palm-lined circuits, and resort backstreets as you climb the ranks to become the ultimate rally champion.Features:- Island Resort Circuits – Race through vibrant tropical courses inspired by beautiful island resorts- Full Car Roster – Choose your ride from a selection of unique vehicles- 1-2 Player Local Multiplayer – Race solo or go head-to-head with a friend on the same screen- 3 Game Modes – Compete in multiple ways to prove your skill- Garage Customization – Personalize your car to match your style- Podium Finishes – Battle for the top spot after every race- Local Leaderboard – Chase the best times and challenge your friends- Save System – Jump back in anytime, right where you left off- French & English Language SupportGrab the wheel, hit the coast, and race your way to victory in the most scenic rally on the island!

releases.name: Cozy Cat Shop
releases.summary:
※本作は日本語に対応しておりません。

街で一番居心地の良い「猫ショップ」を経営してみたいと思ったことはありませんか？

「Cozy Cat Shop（コージー・キャット・ショップ）」へようこそ！ここは、愛らしい猫たち、幸せなお客様、そして無限の可能性が出会う場所です。夢のお店を作り上げ、魅力あふれる様々な猫種と出会い、お客様が運命の猫と巡り合えるような、温かみのある空間を創り出しましょう。

最初は小さなお店からスタートし、賑やかな「猫の楽園」へと成長させていきましょう。スペースを広げ、インテリアを自分好みにカスタマイズし、ビジネスを拡大しながら、たくさんの愛らしい猫たちに囲まれる素敵な毎日を過ごしてください！

主な特徴：
- 多彩な猫種との出会い
- 居心地の良い猫ショップの経営・拡大
- お店のカスタマイズ
- ビジネスの成長

たくさんの愛らしい猫たちと出会いましょう！

releases.name: Crab Evolution Roguelite
releases.summary:
Can you build the perfect mutant and survive every dangerous stage?

Enter a dangerous pixel-art world where survival depends on how far you are willing to transform. Take control of a strange creature and fight through relentless waves of enemies in a fast-paced 2D roguelite where every run brings new dangers, new choices, and new opportunities to evolve.

Collect experience, discover powerful mutations, and reshape your creature with every decision you make. Combine passive effects, active abilities, and physical mutations to create unique builds that can completely change the way you fight and survive. Experiment with different combinations, adapt to unexpected challenges, and find the mutations that turn your creature into an unstoppable force.

Key Features:
• Powerful Mutations: Combine 60+ passive, 30+ active, and 30+ physical mutations to create unique builds.
• Transform Your Creature: Physical mutations change your character's appearance and shape the way you play.
• Fast-Paced Roguelite Action: Fight through intense enemy waves in challenging 2D survival runs.
• 4 Unique Maps: Explore dangerous pixel-art environments filled with different enemies and challenging encounters.
• Every Run Is Different: Adapt to random mutation choices and experiment with new builds every run.

releases.name: Angry Panda
releases.summary:
Bamboo is Gone. Panda is Here.

Turn your zoo enclosure into the ultimate comedy stage in this hilarious first-person 3D panda simulator! Forget sleeping all day - take control of a mischievous bear, prank unsuspecting tourists, and create playful physics sandbox chaos!

You might be behind the exhibit glass, but that won't stop the fun! Fling bamboo at surprised zoo visitors, shake the viewing barriers, tumble across the yard, and complete funny quests for quirky animal neighbors like a grumpy rhino. Solve escape-style mini-games, unlock silly tricks, and keep the zookeepers completely baffled!

KEY FEATURES:
• First-Person 3D Panda Simulator: Experience life from a playful bear’s eye level. Watch your fluffy paws grab items, push obstacles, and roll around your 3D enclosure!
• Prank the Zoo Tourists: Keep the crowds laughing and startled by tossing food, making funny gestures, and pulling off goofy stunts right at the viewing glass.
• Quirky Animal Neighbor Quests: Talk to and help your neighboring exhibit buddies, including running funny errands for a grumpy, demanding rhino.
• Fun Physics & Escape Minigames: Tackle lighthearted obstacle challenges, goofy enclosure breakout attempts, and interactive sandbox puzzles.
• Unlock Silly Abilities & Tricks: Earn points from your daily mischief to unlock ridiculous moves, funny animations, and new ways to cause zoo anarchy!

releases.name: Escape: Immersion
releases.summary: Escape: Immersion is a cinematic 2.5D horror adventure set inside a collapsing underwater military base. Explore flooded corridors, solve environmental puzzles, evade deadly traps, and uncover your past.

releases.name: Tenebris Somnia
releases.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a survival horror adventure game in the same vein as classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil - but adapted to a retro 2D aesthetic from the 8 or 16-bit era.

You will struggle to survive while solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures. 

Yet the secrets of the game lie within its cinematics...

When you reach certain key points you will see sequences from a completely different point of view, made in live action with real actors and practical effects - created by a professional and award winning film crew from Argentina.
